Generate Unique Individual Patient Inputs

gen_unique_pt_inputs.Rd

Generates individual patient-level parameters that are heterogeneous across patients and may depend on treatment history. Called once per new patient at the start of their simulation. Returns a WARDEN add_item() object consumed by run_sim_new via the unique_pt_inputs argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Usage

gen_unique_pt_inputs()

Value

A WARDEN add_item() object containing all individual patient inputs, passed directly to run_sim_new via the unique_pt_inputs argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Details

Parameters are sampled or initialised for each new patient. The current treatment arm is initialised here but is later overwritten by WARDEN with the arm being simulated (arm).

The following parameters are generated:

Sampled at patient entry

  • edss_value — baseline EDSS score (0–9), sampled from a Dirichlet-weighted discrete distribution using the HARRMS row of m_n_patients_edss (MS Registry).

  • sex — patient sex (0 = male, 1 = female), sampled using prop_female (0.70, AFFIRM).

  • spms_flag — indicator for baseline SPMS status (0 = RRMS, 1 = SPMS), sampled using initial_spms_prop (default 0).

  • relapse_hospital_flag — indicator for whether a relapse leads to hospital admission, sampled using p_relapse_hospital (Hawton et al. 2026).

  • current_treatment — initial treatment arm, sampled from v_treatment_names weighted by l_prop_3rdline_trt. Note: overwritten by WARDEN with the arm under simulation (trt).

  • current_treatment_code — numeric code of current_treatment, looked up from v_treatment_codes.

Event history counters (initialised to 0)

  • n_relapse — cumulative number of relapses.

  • n_sae_evts — cumulative number of serious adverse events.

  • n_edssinc_evts — cumulative number of EDSS increases.

  • n_edssdec_evts — cumulative number of EDSS decreases.

  • n_switch — cumulative number of treatment switches (sense check counter).

Time trackers (initialised to 0)

  • t_progression — time spent in progression.

  • t_2ndline, t_3rdline, t_4thline — time spent on 2nd, 3rd, and 4th line treatments respectively.

  • tto_dp1 to tto_dp7 — time to each disability progression event, up to 7 events.

  • tto_rel1 to tto_rel7 — time to each relapse event, up to 7 events.

  • yrs_edss_0 to yrs_edss_9 — annual time spent in each EDSS severity state (0–9).

  • years_on_treatment — cumulative years on current treatment, used for drug acquisition cost calculation.

State flags (initialised to 0)

  • waning — waning of treatment effect flag. Set to 0 by default (no waning); multiplied into the hazard ratio as HR x (1 - waning).

  • treatment_stop — flag set to 1 when EDSS reaches 7 or above, stopping treatment acquisition costs.

Treatment and patient state (initialised)

  • treatment_line — current treatment line, initialised to 2 (all patients start on second-line therapy).

  • age — baseline age, set to inputs[["initial_age"]].

Cost and utility accumulators (initialised to 0)

  • utilities_disease — accumulated disease utility.

  • costs_disease — accumulated disease costs.

  • costs_treatment — accumulated treatment costs.

  • utilities_relapse — accumulated relapse utility.

  • costs_relapse — accumulated relapse costs.

  • utilities_sae — accumulated SAE utility.

  • costs_sae — accumulated SAE costs.
